comparison.objective: PR-1924 lands a hoisted motor over four studs while operating a pendant; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop on a bench fixture.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1924 tests suspended-load steering, four-hole alignment, and simultaneous hold-to-run control under pinch constraints, not two-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1924 requires all feet seated, chain slack, controls released, and no unsafe load interaction; the candidate requires locked angular retention over three cycles.
comparison.reason: Precision landing of a swinging heavy load is meaningfully different from threaded calibration and locknut tightening.
